likes = values('W1::Likelihoods', 'G410:H412')

prior_dict = {row[1]: row[0] for row in priors}
hypotheses = list(prior_dict.keys())
# P(negative | H) = 1 - Positive
# P(two negatives | H) = (1 - Positive)^2
# P(H | two negatives) = P(two negatives | H) * Prior / sum_over_h (P(two negatives | h) * Prior(h))
post_probs = {}
denom = 0
for h in hypotheses:
    pr = prior_dict[h]
    pos = like_dict[h]
    p_two_neg_given_h = (1 - pos) ** 2
    val = p_two_neg_given_h * pr
    post_probs[h] = val
    denom += val
clear_prob = post_probs['Clear source'] / denom
result = round(clear_prob, 6)
